newsitem.title: UK: Gilts to skip higher before consumer credit data.
newsitem.headline: Gilts to skip higher before consumer credit data.

text.p: 0630 GMT - Gilts expected to open higher ahead of consumer credit data, forecast to show an 856 million stg increase in borrowing in March. Last days of election campaign provide backdrop but US durable goods and consumer credit data will hold most attention. * June gilt future settled at 109-02 on Monday
